biotools.summary: The Path Environment Audit Tool (PEAT) is used to assess the accessibility of public parks for wheelchair users. The tool was utilized in a study evaluating five parks in Saudi Arabia, and the findings were published in the Hong Kong Journal of Occupational Therapy.
